answer: Each agent deposits bonded stake and, after joining the Semaphore tree, evaluates an epoch polynomial whose committed coefficients bind its RLN rate-limit share. A unique nullifier accompanies every message; reuse in the same epoch yields two polynomial points, allowing Shamir secret sharing to reconstruct the private key and trigger instantaneous collateral slashing. The thread, karst, and vine labels are domain-separated epochs, not additional identities.
